Hero.title: We build digital systems that make businesses work better.
Hero.description: We design and build digital solutions that connect technology, processes, and data to create simpler, more efficient, and scalable operations.

SystemProblem.title: Most companies waste time and money on processes nobody designed on purpose.
SystemProblem.description: Tools that don’t talk to each other, manual customer follow-up, information scattered across five places. It’s not a lack of technology — it’s a system problem.

ProblemSolutions.title: What we solve
ProblemSolutions.description: Technology should simplify your operation, not add more complexity. We help businesses solve problems such as:

manualRepetitive.title: Manual and repetitive processes
manualRepetitive.body: We turn repetitive tasks into automated workflows that save time and reduce operational friction.

disconnectedTools.title: Disconnected tools
disconnectedTools.body: We connect platforms, systems, and data so your technology works as one ecosystem.

disorganizedCustomer.title: Disorganized customer management
disorganizedCustomer.body: We implement CRM systems that centralize leads, customers, conversations, and commercial processes.

hardToScale.title: Processes that are difficult to scale
hardToScale.body: We build digital systems and automations designed to support growth without multiplying manual work.

digitalExperiences.title: Digital experiences that need improvement
digitalExperiences.body: We develop websites, web applications, landing pages, and interfaces built around real business needs.

lackOfVisibility.title: Lack of visibility and reliable data
lackOfVisibility.body: We implement tracking and data flows that help businesses understand what is happening across their digital ecosystem.

Capabilities.title: What we build
Capabilities.description: Four capabilities. Combined as one system for your business.

development.title: Development
development.body: Digital products and experiences built around real business needs.
development.items: Websites · Landing Pages · Web Apps · MVPs · Dashboards · Custom Frontend Development

automation.title: Automation
automation.body: Systems that reduce repetitive work and improve how businesses operate.
automation.items: CRM Implementation · Commercial Workflows · Internal Processes · Email · WhatsApp · Customer Journeys

integration.title: Integration
integration.body: We connect the tools your business already uses so information can move automatically between them.
integration.items: APIs · Webhooks · CRM Integrations · Payment Platforms · Forms · Calendars · Marketing Tools

appliedAi.title: Applied AI
appliedAi.body: We integrate AI into real processes where it can improve efficiency, response times, and operations.
appliedAi.items: AI Assistants · AI-powered Workflows · Process Automation · AI Integrations

ExperienceStats.title: Experience behind Jera Labs
ExperienceStats.closing: Jera Labs brings together technical development and business automation to build solutions that work beyond the interface.

ThinkingProcess.title: How we work
ThinkingProcess.description: A clear process from the problem to a working solution.

diagnosis.title: Diagnosis
diagnosis.body: We understand your business, the problem you need to solve, your current processes, and the technology you already use.

proposal.title: Proposal
proposal.body: We define the solution, scope, technologies, implementation plan, and deliverables.

implementation.title: Implementation
implementation.body: We develop, configure, automate, and integrate the systems required for the project.

testing.title: Testing
testing.body: We test the solution, integrations, workflows, and critical scenarios before launch.

deliverySupport.title: Delivery & Support
deliverySupport.body: We deploy the solution, document what was implemented, and provide the support required for a smooth transition.

ProjectsExperience.title: Projects & Experience
ProjectsExperience.description: Jera Labs may be a new studio, but the experience behind it isn’t.
ProjectsExperience.body: Together, we’ve worked on more than 15 projects involving development, CRM implementation, automation, integrations, digital operations, and technology infrastructure.
ProjectsExperience.closing: Today, we bring that experience together under Jera Labs to build better digital systems for businesses.

WhyJera.title: More than isolated tools
WhyJera.lead: A website, a CRM, an automation, or an AI solution shouldn’t exist in isolation.
WhyJera.body: We look at the entire digital ecosystem behind a business and build solutions that connect technology with the way the company actually operates.
WhyJera.closing: That means fewer disconnected tools, less manual work, better information flow, and technology that can evolve with the business.

FoundersPreview.title: Who we are
FoundersPreview.description: Jera Labs was founded around a simple idea: development and automation work better when they are designed together.
FoundersPreview.bridge: We combine two complementary areas of expertise to build digital solutions that are technically solid, operationally useful, and designed around how a business actually works.

alejandro.name: Alejandro Lucas
alejandro.body: 5 years of experience building frontend applications, digital products, and technology solutions.

karla.name: Karla Vázquez
karla.body: 6 years of experience building CRM systems, automations, funnels, integrations, and digital operations.

JeraMeaning.title: Growth is also a system.
JeraMeaning.description: Jera is the Nordic rune of harvest and cycles: the result of a constant process, not a shortcut.
JeraMeaning.closing: That’s how we understand technology: solid foundations, continuous improvement, solutions that grow with the business.

FinalCta.title: Let’s talk about your project
FinalCta.description: You don’t need to know exactly what technology you need. Tell us what you want to build, improve, automate, or solve, and we’ll help you define the right approach.
